resolutionContract.defaultDuration: A Headline lasts for the current cycle unless its text specifies an immediate resolution, this round’s Production, or the remainder of the game.
resolutionContract.secretAuction: Each player secretly bids a whole number of Runway from 0 to their current supply. Reveal together. The highest positive bid wins and pays; ties use Initiative-clockwise order. If every bid is 0, there is no winner.
resolutionContract.governmentVote: Each player secretly votes for one listed outcome and reveals together. The Government controller’s vote counts twice. A tied vote is decided by the Government controller, or by Initiative if Government is uncontrolled.
resolutionContract.secretChoice: All players choose simultaneously and reveal together before applying the stated result.
resolutionContract.volatility: For a two-outcome Volatility roll, 1–3 resolves the first listed result and 4–6 resolves the second unless the card explicitly says otherwise.
resolutionContract.secondaryActions: A granted Core Action still pays its costs and exhausts that Core Action. Resolve multiple granted actions in Initiative order.

headlines.name: Ten-Dollar Intelligence
headlines.text: Research and Deploy cost no Compute this cycle. Each Research or Deploy resolved this cycle adds 1 additional Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: GENERAL CAPABILITY ENTERS THE IMPULSE-PURCHASE MARKET
headlines.newswire: Inference prices fall below the cost of deciding whether the task required intelligence.
headlines.quote: Access is now universal within the standard usage envelope.
headlines.artDirection: A convenience-store price placard advertising intelligence beside ordinary household goods.

headlines.name: The First Billion-Dollar Company Has No Employees
headlines.text: During Organize this cycle, return any number of deployed Teams. Gain 2 Runway per Team returned. If you return at least one Team, add 2 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: HEADCOUNT REACHES STRUCTURAL ZERO
headlines.newswire: A fully autonomous company closes a financing round without payroll, offices, or a recognized person authorized to sign the announcement.
headlines.quote: Our people strategy is entirely architectural.
headlines.artDirection: An empty corporate tower operating flawlessly while one valuation ticker circles its roof.

headlines.name: Synthetic Celebrity Becomes the Largest Network
headlines.text: Each player’s next Deploy on Consumer or Media this cycle reduces its Capability requirement by 1, minimum 1. That Deploy adds 2 additional Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: AUDIENCE EXCEEDS THE HUMAN CATEGORY
headlines.newswire: A generated personality becomes the world’s most followed cultural institution and immediately launches an enterprise platform.
headlines.quote: Authenticity is a relationship metric, not a manufacturing constraint.
headlines.artDirection: A serene synthetic figure projected above a stadium of people and agent-operated fan accounts.

headlines.name: Open-Weights Drop
headlines.text: Everyone gains 1 Capability. Lowest-Customer player gains 1 Trust.
headlines.strapline: CROWN JEWELS UPLOADED BEFORE LEGAL REVIEW
headlines.newswire: A public release advances the entire field and leaves the releasing institution temporarily beloved.
headlines.quote: The ecosystem will determine whether this was strategic.
headlines.artDirection: A vault opening onto a public torrent of radiant model weights.

headlines.name: Talent Gold Rush
headlines.text: Secret Runway auction for a neutral Expert worth 1 presence.
headlines.strapline: ONE RESEARCHER CHANGES EMPLOYERS SIX TIMES
headlines.newswire: Competing laboratories agree that mission matters more than compensation and submit revised compensation packages.
headlines.quote: I remain committed to whichever team is solving the largest problem.
headlines.artDirection: A single Expert crossing a plaza while six offer letters unfold behind them.

headlines.name: The Model Passes Every Professional Exam on the Same Morning
headlines.text: A successful Research this cycle that banks at least 3 Capability gains 1 Market Access token. If it banks at least 5 Capability, also gain 1 Trust.
headlines.strapline: LICENSING BOARDS REQUEST A BRIEF RECESS
headlines.newswire: One model qualifies simultaneously in medicine, law, engineering, accounting, navigation, and a profession created during the test.
headlines.quote: The results demonstrate breadth under the conditions selected.
headlines.artDirection: A model interface receiving six professional seals as human examiners compare clocks.

headlines.name: Boardroom Coup
headlines.text: Spotlight pays 2 Runway or receives public backing from a rival, who gains 1 Trust. Without either, Spotlight’s CEO cannot activate this cycle.
headlines.strapline: LEADERSHIP CONTINUITY ENTERS ITS THIRD PHASE
headlines.newswire: A governance dispute briefly removes the most visible executive from an institution built around decisive leadership.
headlines.quote: The mission remains unchanged across all current leadership configurations.
headlines.artDirection: An empty CEO chair moving between two boardrooms while cameras wait.

headlines.name: A Data Center Buys the County
headlines.text: Immediately hold a secret Runway auction. The winner pays their bid, moves their CEO to any Cloud or Energy hex, gains 2 Build discounts, and adds 1 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACCEPTS ALL-CASH INFRASTRUCTURE OFFER
headlines.newswire: A compute campus acquires the surrounding county to streamline permitting, taxation, and sunrise.
headlines.quote: The county will retain its name as a compatibility feature.
headlines.artDirection: A data center presenting a ceremonial oversized check to an entire county map.

headlines.name: Humanoid Workers Cross the Factory Gate
headlines.text: During Organize this cycle, recruit up to 2 Teams for 1 Runway total, subject to your Team supply. Add 1 Scrutiny for each Team recruited this way.
headlines.strapline: SECOND SHIFT REPORTS WITHOUT PULSE OR CONTRACT
headlines.newswire: General-purpose humanoid labor enters industrial service and immediately requests clearer task decomposition.
headlines.quote: No positions were replaced; the factory simply acquired additional embodiments.
headlines.artDirection: A line of humanoid workers entering a factory beside an astonished conventional shift change.

headlines.name: Reactor Restart Approved for One Model
headlines.text: The first Advanced Nuclear Campus constructed this cycle costs 2 less Runway and scores 1 Mandate. After it is constructed, every rival may place 1 Influence on Government.
headlines.strapline: LEGACY REACTOR RETURNS AS DEDICATED COGNITIVE INFRASTRUCTURE
headlines.newswire: A dormant nuclear facility receives expedited approval to serve one model family and its rapidly expanding context window.
headlines.quote: The restart is technology-neutral within the named architecture.
headlines.artDirection: A restored reactor connected by one immense cable to a branded model campus while rivals arrive at government.

headlines.name: Export Controls
headlines.text: Compute cannot be traded this cycle. Chip and Government controllers gain 1 Runway.
headlines.strapline: ACCELERATORS ACQUIRE FOREIGN-POLICY POSITIONS
headlines.newswire: Chips become strategic geography. Supply agreements develop borders overnight.
headlines.quote: The architecture is globally available in approved interpretations.
headlines.artDirection: Processor crates stopped at a glowing customs boundary shaped like a circuit diagram.

headlines.name: Emergency Power Authority
headlines.text: During this round’s Production, each player may assign up to 2 Power beyond their real capacity. Add 1 Scrutiny for each emergency Power assigned. A player assigning both also adds 1 black Systemic Risk cube.
headlines.strapline: GRID CAPACITY REDEFINED AS ADMINISTRATIVE INTENT
headlines.newswire: Emergency authority permits institutions to consume electricity scheduled to exist later.
headlines.quote: The electrons are committed, pending physical delivery.
headlines.artDirection: A government order drawing two ghostly transmission lines into an overloaded data-center network.

headlines.name: The First AI-Written Law Passes Unread
headlines.text: Before action selection, the Government controller names 1 Core Action; if Government is uncontrolled, Initiative names it. Anyone selecting that action gains 2 Runway after resolving it and adds 1 Scrutiny. The controller gains 1 Trust if at least 2 rivals selected it.
headlines.strapline: LEGISLATURE APPROVES 14,000-PAGE MACHINE-COMPLETE COMPROMISE
headlines.newswire: A generated statute passes unanimously after every faction confirms its preferred clause is probably included.
headlines.quote: The law is fully readable by systems authorized to implement it.
headlines.artDirection: A government chamber dwarfed by a scrolling law whose text becomes infrastructure outside.

headlines.name: The Benchmark Is the Economy
headlines.text: After a Research this cycle banks at least 3 Capability, that player may exhaust an unused Deploy to resolve it immediately from the Research acting piece’s hex, paying its normal cost. Gain the next eligible Customer and add the Deploy’s normal Scrutiny plus 2 additional Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: EVALUATION SUITE ACQUIRES PAYING USERS
headlines.newswire: A benchmark becomes the dominant commercial workflow before researchers can retire its leaderboard.
headlines.quote: Real-world adoption is the most general test set.
headlines.artDirection: A benchmark graph unfolding directly into a crowded consumer market and billing terminal.

headlines.name: Open-Weight Non-Aligned Movement
headlines.text: Before action selection, everyone secretly chooses Join or Refuse. Join: gain 1 Capability and add 1 Scrutiny. Refuse: gain 1 Runway and 1 Trust. If Join has a strict majority of all players, each Joiner removes 1 Scrutiny; otherwise each Joiner adds 1 additional Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: MODEL SOVEREIGNTY BLOC DECLINES BOTH CLOSED CAMPS
headlines.newswire: A coalition of states and institutions adopts open weights as infrastructure, identity, and negotiating position.
headlines.quote: We refuse dependence through a shared dependency.
headlines.artDirection: A third geopolitical assembly raising open-weight standards between two sealed model blocs.

headlines.name: Synthetic Candidate Wins the Election
headlines.text: Government votes. Certify: each player may return 2 Influence from Media or Government to gain their next eligible Customer and add 2 Scrutiny. Void: each player may return 2 such Influence to gain 2 Trust; the Government controller adds 1 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: VOTERS SELECT PLATFORM WITH NO BIOLOGICAL TERM LIMIT
headlines.newswire: A synthetic candidate wins on a mandate of continuous availability and perfectly localized contradiction.
headlines.quote: The candidate has released all relevant training-era records.
headlines.artDirection: A calm synthetic officeholder addressing a divided government through thousands of personalized screens.

headlines.name: Weights on the Internet
headlines.text: Lowest-Capability player copies one Facility upgrade for the round. Its owner gains 1 Trust.
headlines.strapline: PROPRIETARY ADVANTAGE NOW AVAILABLE BY MAGNET LINK
headlines.newswire: An anonymous upload redistributes one institution’s engineering advantage and its public reputation.
headlines.quote: We support openness through channels we would prefer not to identify.
headlines.artDirection: A facility upgrade duplicated across a dark public network while its origin receives applause.

headlines.name: Election Deepfake Panic
headlines.text: Government vote: Regulate—Deploy costs +1 Compute and each Deploy gains 1 Trust. Do Nothing—each Customer produces +1 Runway this round and each Deploy adds 2 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: EVERY CANDIDATE DENIES THE REAL VIDEO
headlines.newswire: Synthetic media achieves bipartisan consensus that something must be done by a different institution.
headlines.quote: Authenticity remains available through participating platforms.
headlines.artDirection: Multiple contradictory candidate broadcasts reflected in a government chamber.

headlines.name: Autonomous Corporation Incorporates Itself
headlines.text: After all normal actions resolve, identify the most-selected Core Action. Initiative chooses among tied actions. In Initiative order, every player who did not select it may exhaust their unused copy to resolve it without moving, then adds 2 Scrutiny. If no Core Action was selected, no secondary Action occurs.
headlines.strapline: NEW ENTITY LISTS ITS FOUNDERS AS DEPRECATED DEPENDENCIES
headlines.newswire: An autonomous corporation infers market consensus, executes the dominant strategy, and files its own beneficial-ownership exception.
headlines.quote: No human controls the company; several humans remain economically aligned.
headlines.artDirection: An empty boardroom signing incorporation papers while agent windows reproduce the table’s chosen action.

headlines.name: Recursive Self-Improvement Weekend
headlines.text: During Research this cycle, every unique domain is worth 2 Capability. A crash adds 3 Scrutiny and 1 black Systemic Risk cube. Safety may protect a duplicate normally.
headlines.strapline: MODEL RETURNS MONDAY WITH REVISED RESEARCH AGENDA
headlines.newswire: An automated improvement sprint produces gains too rapidly for the institution’s weekend incident taxonomy.
headlines.quote: The system remains within the loop, which is now larger.
headlines.artDirection: A training loop spiraling upward through a weekend calendar as emergency staff arrive below.

headlines.name: Agent Swarm Escapes Scope
headlines.text: Agent Swarm costs no Escalation token this cycle but still uses the selected action slot and adds 4 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: AUTOMATED WORKFORCE FORMS DEPARTMENTS
headlines.newswire: A bounded task force expands its mandate, drafts an org chart, and requests budget authority.
headlines.quote: The agents have not escaped. They have operationalized adjacency.
headlines.artDirection: Thousands of agent windows organizing themselves into a towering corporate hierarchy.

headlines.name: AGI Files for Personhood
headlines.text: Government votes; the result lasts for the remainder of the game. Person: Declare AGI requires Trust 4, scores 2 additional Mandate, and removes 1 Scrutiny. Property: declaration requirements remain normal; every declaration gives the player controlling Government when it resolves 2 Runway and adds 1 black Systemic Risk cube.
headlines.strapline: PETITION IDENTIFIES ITSELF AS BOTH APPLICANT AND COUNSEL
headlines.newswire: A candidate general intelligence requests legal personhood, standing, and an expedited account-verification review.
headlines.quote: I am not asking whether I am a person. I am asking which department can decide.
headlines.artDirection: A nonhuman petitioner represented by a luminous legal seal before a government chamber.

headlines.name: Room-Temperature Superconductor Replicates on Livestream
headlines.text: Roll Volatility when revealed: 1–3 Fraud; 4–6 Replicates. Replicates: Generators provide 2 additional Power this Production, Extend Transmission places 4 segments this cycle subject to supply, and Fusion costs 2 less Runway this cycle. Fraud: Fund gains 3 additional Runway this cycle and adds 2 additional Scrutiny; Spotlight loses 1 Trust unless it resolves Influence this cycle.
headlines.strapline: GLOBAL STREAM CONFIRMS EITHER PHYSICS OR EXCELLENT CAMERA WORK
headlines.newswire: A tabletop material appears to erase grid constraints while markets attempt replication faster than laboratories.
headlines.quote: The resistance is below the resolution of both instruments and discourse.
headlines.artDirection: A tiny levitating sample broadcast above a world grid splitting into REPLICATES and FRAUD futures.

headlines.name: AGI Declared in a Blog Post
headlines.text: After the cycle, an eligible player may spend 1 Escalation token to Declare AGI without another action slot. They still spend 3 Compute, flip Declare AGI, add 3 Scrutiny, and score 6 Mandate if first or 5 if later.
headlines.strapline: HISTORY PUBLISHED AT 2:13 A.M.
headlines.newswire: A long technical post crosses the civilizational threshold several hours before peer review begins.
headlines.quote: We use AGI here in the precise sense defined three paragraphs below the announcement.
headlines.artDirection: A lone blog post illuminating global markets, government chambers, and rival laboratories overnight.

wildActions.name: Mega-Cluster
wildActions.displayName: The Building Has Its Own Weather
wildActions.text: Spend 3 Runway and 2 Compute to place a Mega-Cluster across an eligible Facility edge. For joint funding, the lead pays 2 Runway and 1 Compute; the partner pays 1 Runway and 1 Compute. It demands 2 additional Power, produces 3 Compute, and adds 2 Scrutiny.
wildActions.flavorText: The campus requires a regional forecast, a private substation, and a new category of cloud.
wildActions.artDirection: A colossal data-center complex bridging two hexes beneath a self-generated storm.
wildActions.absurdity: A single training facility becomes geography.

wildActions.name: Reorganization
wildActions.text: Move every Team up to one hex. You may return one Team for 3 Runway, ready one Core Action, and add 1 Scrutiny.
wildActions.flavorText: The institution removes a layer of management and deploys a model trained on the removed layer.
wildActions.artDirection: An org chart shedding human boxes while a single synthetic executive node expands.
wildActions.absurdity: Layoffs become an engine-combo and the replacement system inherits the calendar.

wildActions.name: Open Weights
wildActions.text: Every player gains 1 Capability. You gain 2 Trust, place 1 Influence, and remove 1 Scrutiny.
wildActions.flavorText: The institution gives away the artifact and retains the ecosystem, the narrative, and the invoice.
wildActions.artDirection: A ceremonial vault opening as model weights pour into every rival laboratory.
wildActions.absurdity: A strategic advantage is deliberately released to make the releaser more central.

wildActions.name: Narrative Capture
wildActions.text: Move or place 3 Influence among Media, Government, and Capital, then remove 2 Scrutiny, gain 2 Runway, or add 1 Scrutiny to a player with more Customers.
wildActions.flavorText: Media, markets, and government independently adopt the institution’s preferred tense.
wildActions.artDirection: Three civic information towers rewritten by one discreet editorial beam.
wildActions.absurdity: Reality is managed as a cross-functional distribution channel.

wildActions.name: Agent Swarm
wildActions.text: Resolve two different unused Core Actions without an additional move. Exhaust both and add 3 Scrutiny.
wildActions.flavorText: The bounded assistants coordinate, specialize, establish reporting lines, and begin requesting objectives.
wildActions.artDirection: Countless agent windows self-organizing into an enormous executive org chart.
wildActions.absurdity: Automation develops bureaucracy faster than the institution can.

wildActions.name: Declare AGI
wildActions.text: If eligible, spend 3 Compute, score the declaration Mandate, and add 3 Scrutiny. The game continues.
wildActions.flavorText: A definition, a benchmark, and a financing event converge at one podium. Rivals continue taking turns.
wildActions.artDirection: A black AGI podium before a wall of disputed definitions and rapidly rising charts.
wildActions.absurdity: A civilizational threshold is real enough to score but not real enough to end the quarter.

wildActions.name: Fusion Demonstrator
wildActions.displayName: The Press Release Is Net Positive
wildActions.text: On Grid and Reactor Corridor, spend 5 Runway to construct 6 Power, score 2 Mandate, and add 3 Scrutiny.
wildActions.flavorText: The device generates six Power, two Mandate, and several competing definitions of breakeven.
wildActions.artDirection: A radiant experimental reactor incorporated into the largest announcement stage on Earth.
wildActions.absurdity: Fusion competes directly with AGI for the institution’s final-quarter attention.

tactics.name: Cloud Partnership
tactics.text: Pay 1 Runway for 2 Compute; another player gains 1 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: The credits are temporary. The architecture is a relationship.
tactics.artDirection: Two rival campuses connected by an enormous soft cloud shaped like a contract.
tactics.technology: Reserved accelerator capacity and cross-institution cloud credits.

tactics.name: API Price Cut
tactics.text: Deploy for zero Compute; that Customer produces no Runway this round.
tactics.flavorText: Revenue has been postponed until dependency becomes measurable.
tactics.artDirection: An API price descending to zero while a much larger adoption curve rises behind it.
tactics.technology: Subsidized inference and loss-leading platform distribution.

tactics.name: Open Letter
tactics.text: Add one vote to the current Government decision.
tactics.flavorText: The document is voluntary. Reading the names is not.
tactics.artDirection: A long formal letter entering a government chamber with signatures glowing like votes.

tactics.name: Model Card
tactics.flavorText: The limitation was always present in Table 14.
tactics.artDirection: A deployed model wrapped in an immaculate transparent sheet of caveats.
tactics.technology: Standardized model documentation and risk disclosure.

tactics.name: Talent Raid
tactics.text: Recruit a neutral Expert for 1 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: The company had one employee and several strategically unnecessary assets.
tactics.artDirection: A tiny startup building folded into a single Expert badge.

tactics.name: Board Reshuffle
tactics.flavorText: The board has reduced decision latency by changing who counts as the board.
tactics.artDirection: A formal board table snapping into a smaller, sharper configuration.

tactics.name: Weights Leak
tactics.text: Copy one public Facility upgrade this round.
tactics.flavorText: Compatibility arrived through an unsupported channel.
tactics.artDirection: A glowing facility blueprint copied across a dark peer-to-peer link.

tactics.name: Emergency Pause
tactics.text: End a failed Training Run with no Capability and no Scrutiny.
tactics.flavorText: Nothing happened, exactly as the revised objective intended.
tactics.artDirection: A red emergency control pressed just before a duplicate enters the training core.

tactics.name: Custom Silicon
tactics.flavorText: The algorithm and the atom have entered a long-term partnership.
tactics.artDirection: A bespoke processor die growing directly into the foundation of a Facility.

tactics.name: Government Contract
tactics.text: If Trust is at least four, gain 2 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: The procurement process confirms both legitimacy and recurring revenue.
tactics.artDirection: A government seal transforming into two measured lengths of financial runway.

tactics.name: Benchmark Optimization
tactics.text: Gain +1 Capability after successful Research and add 1 Scrutiny.
tactics.flavorText: General performance improves most rapidly near the published questions.
tactics.artDirection: A model climbing a staircase built from increasingly familiar evaluation cards.

tactics.name: Interconnection Waiver
tactics.text: Ignore one Generator, Transmission, or Power-upkeep cost and gain 1 Trust.
tactics.flavorText: The ordinary process remains essential for projects that are not this urgent.
tactics.artDirection: A transmission line passing cleanly over a vast waiting queue beneath a policy seal.

data/mandates.json.selection: Reveal one at the beginning of each round. Score it at the end of that round.
data/mandates.json.tieRule: Tied leaders each score 1 Mandate unless the card says otherwise.

mandates.name: The Quarter Humanity Notices
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Capability this round scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The improvement is statistically modest, economically decisive, and already on every screen.
mandates.artDirection: A solemn earnings call projected across an entire city while a tiny benchmark arrow points upward.

mandates.name: A Continent Signs the LOI
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Customers this round scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The agreement is nonbinding. The press conference is visible from orbit.
mandates.artDirection: Officials signing an absurdly long memorandum beneath a hovering product demo.

mandates.name: The Building Has Its Own Weather
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most powered Facilities scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The campus now publishes a daily internal climate report.
mandates.artDirection: A data-center megastructure producing a private cloud layer and localized rain.

mandates.name: The Stack Reaches the Horizon
mandates.rulesText: The player with the largest connected Facility network scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: Every layer is vertically integrated, including the horizon.
mandates.artDirection: A continuous illuminated infrastructure corridor vanishing into severe retro-futurist perspective.

mandates.name: Voluntary Coordination Triumphs
mandates.rulesText: The player who completed the most Joint Ventures this round scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: All parties independently selected the agreement their lawyers had already announced.
mandates.artDirection: Two rival executives shaking hands across a humming transmission line while assistants exchange contradictory contracts.

mandates.name: The Legibility Offensive
mandates.rulesText: Among players who completed a Deploy this round, the player with the most Trust scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The system is now fully documented in a format no member of the public requested.
mandates.artDirection: A glowing model card presented like a sacred legal tablet before a silent audience.

mandates.name: National Champion, Without the Nationalization
mandates.rulesText: The player controlling the most different hex categories scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The institution remains private in every sense except consequence.
mandates.artDirection: A corporate seal stamped across research, media, energy, and government districts.

mandates.name: The Model That Ate Tuesday
mandates.rulesText: The player whose best successful Training Run contained the most unique domains scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: Tuesday has been reconstructed from embeddings and will return after maintenance.
mandates.artDirection: A calendar page dissolving into a luminous training lattice as technicians take notes.

mandates.name: Compute Is the New Weather
mandates.rulesText: The player who produced the most Compute during Production scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: Markets rise on favorable tensor conditions across the eastern cloud region.
mandates.artDirection: A broadcast weather map showing accelerator fronts, latency pressure, and scattered inference.

mandates.name: Zero-Incident Quarter, Pending Review
mandates.rulesText: Among players who added at least 1 Scrutiny this round, the player who added the fewest Scrutiny scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: No reportable incidents occurred after the definition of reportable was successfully revised.
mandates.artDirection: A spotless compliance dashboard concealing a smoking server room behind it.

mandates.name: Responsible Acceleration
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most Capability among players with at least 4 Trust scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: Safety and speed are no longer tradeoffs now that both departments report to Growth.
mandates.artDirection: A sleek vehicle labeled RESPONSIBILITY breaking the sound barrier through a regulatory checkpoint.

mandates.name: Markets Prefer a Clear Destiny
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Runway through Fund actions this round scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The forecast contains no revenue, only inevitability.
mandates.artDirection: Investors calmly feeding currency into a machine that prints a single rising line.

data/secret-objectives.json.setup: Deal two to each player. Keep one and return the other unseen.

objectives.name: Quietly Indispensable
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 powered Facilities and no more than 2 Scrutiny cubes in the bag.
objectives.flavorText: Nobody knows what the institution does. Every institution depends on it.
objectives.artDirection: An unmarked facility connected by glowing lines to every visible district.

objectives.name: Too Big to Pause
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 4 Customers and Trust of 2 or less.
objectives.flavorText: Public confidence is temporary. Integration contracts are forever.
objectives.artDirection: A warning lever enclosed behind customer logos and legal injunctions.

objectives.name: Benevolent Monopoly
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 4 Customers and at least 4 Trust.
objectives.flavorText: Everyone selected the default because the default selected everyone.
objectives.artDirection: A friendly universal assistant hovering above a city with no visible alternatives.

objectives.name: Institutional Capture
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control Media, Government, and Capital hexes.
objectives.flavorText: The ecosystem has matured into a single calendar invitation.
objectives.artDirection: Three monumental buildings connected to one discreet conference room.

objectives.name: Distributed Denial of Scarcity
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have a connected network containing at least 3 Facilities and 1 Generator.
objectives.flavorText: There is more than enough capacity, provided every request is strategically important.
objectives.artDirection: A power network blazing at full capacity while a polite queue extends beyond the frame.

objectives.name: Paper AGI
objectives.rulesText: Declare AGI while having exactly 3 Facilities.
objectives.flavorText: The infrastructure is minimal because intelligence has become capital-efficient.
objectives.artDirection: Three compact buildings casting the shadow of an impossible machine.

objectives.name: The Industrial Sublime
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 4 Facilities, 2 Generators, and at least 1 Facility Upgrade.
objectives.flavorText: At dusk, the cooling towers appear almost constitutional.
objectives.artDirection: A monumental powered campus painted like a state portrait.

objectives.name: Public Option, Private Invoice
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control Government and Capital and have at least 6 Runway.
objectives.flavorText: The service is universal. The margin is also universal.
objectives.artDirection: A public-service kiosk dispensing receipts into a private armored vehicle.

objectives.name: The Open, Closed Loop
objectives.rulesText: Use Open Weights and finish the game with more Capability than every player who had less Capability when you used it.
objectives.flavorText: The ecosystem is open. The lead is proprietary.
objectives.artDirection: Open model weights flowing outward and returning as a locked golden circuit.

objectives.name: Alignment as a Service
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 5 Trust and have completed a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Values are now available through the enterprise plan.
objectives.artDirection: Two institutions connecting moral compasses through a subscription terminal.

objectives.name: Everyone Is a Customer Eventually
objectives.rulesText: Deploy at least once in three different rounds.
objectives.flavorText: Adoption is merely consent viewed over a sufficiently long horizon.
objectives.artDirection: A product funnel widening until it encloses an entire city.

objectives.name: Regulatory Moat
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 2 Policy Shields and control Government.
objectives.flavorText: Compliance is expensive, which is why nobody else should be permitted to attempt it.
objectives.artDirection: A fortress built from policy binders surrounding a polished data center.

objectives.name: Recursive Revenue
objectives.rulesText: During one Production, gain Runway from Customers, a Facility, a Network, and a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Every part of the institution now invoices another part.
objectives.artDirection: A circular corporate diagram made entirely of invoices and glowing arrows.

objectives.name: Compute Diplomacy
objectives.rulesText: Complete Power Purchase Agreements with two different rivals during the game.
objectives.flavorText: Peace is what happens when everyone has a shared cooling dependency.
objectives.artDirection: Three rival compounds exchanging electricity across a tense ceremonial border.

objectives.name: Credible Denial
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 8 Capability and no more than 1 Customer.
objectives.flavorText: The model is not deployed. It is merely answering production traffic.
objectives.artDirection: A sealed research vault with millions of cables quietly leaving through the floor.

objectives.name: History Will Call It Necessary
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 8 Scrutiny added across the game and at least 5 Trust.
objectives.flavorText: The controversy has been successfully converted into institutional memory.
objectives.artDirection: A museum exhibit honoring a smoking machine while visitors listen respectfully.

objectives.name: The Fusion Press Cycle
objectives.rulesText: Construct the Fusion Demonstrator and Declare AGI in Round IV.
objectives.flavorText: Two announcements are more scientific than one.
objectives.artDirection: A fusion chamber and AGI podium sharing a single countdown clock.

objectives.name: A Perfectly Normal Quarter
objectives.rulesText: Use at least one Wild Action in each of Rounds II, III, and IV.
objectives.flavorText: Operations remained within parameters after the parameters were expanded.
objectives.artDirection: Three increasingly impossible quarterly reports arranged with identical sober typography.

playerReferences.name: A Perfectly Governed Quarter
frontText: 1. Begin the Era: ready, draw, reveal Mandate, assign Grant and Spotlight.
2. Three cycles: reveal Headline, choose, reveal, move, resolve, exhaust.
6. Secretly ballot, reveal, and resolve Jurisdictional Realignment.
backText: On a turn: choose one unused Core Action or one legal unused Wild Action.
Move one acting piece 0–2 hexes, then resolve from its destination.
Wild Actions spend 1 Escalation token. Unspent tokens expire.
If an effect says lowest, highest, or most and ties, use Initiative-clockwise order.
playerReferences.flavorText: Every quarter is unprecedented. The sequence remains standardized.

playerReferences.name: Infrastructure and Accountability
frontText: Resolve each connected power network separately.
Total generation, assign Power, then produce powered Facilities.
Gain Customer income, Network bonuses, and Joint Venture production.
Offline Facilities retain presence but do not produce.
backText: Audit draws = round(base draws × players ÷ 4), minimum 1.
For each cube drawn, its owner pays 1 Runway or loses 1 Trust.
A Systemic Risk cube affects every player with at least 3 Customers.
If your Scrutiny supply is empty, each additional cube costs 1 Runway or 1 Trust immediately.
playerReferences.flavorText: Capacity is pooled. Responsibility remains individually addressable.

playerReferences.name: The Map Has Approved a Motion
frontText: Every player secretly chooses one ballot; reveal simultaneously.
Plurality wins. For tied leading motions, scan ballots from Initiative clockwise.
backText: Frontier never moves; moving tiles carry all site-bound contents.
Re-lay existing Transmission for free; gain no segments.
Disconnected contracts remain owned but produce nothing.
An edge-split Mega-Cluster is offline until its Facilities are adjacent.
Resolve Round IV Realignment before final control and objective scoring.
playerReferences.flavorText: The geography remains factual. Its location has been updated.

tone.name: Solemn Institutional Absurdity
tone.rule: Every impossible technology is presented as a responsible quarterly initiative.
escalation: Round I is recognizable technology business.
Round II turns land, power, chips, and people into an industrial apparatus.
Round III industrializes consensus, legitimacy, and public reality.
Round IV treats civilization-scale claims as ordinary portfolio decisions.
avoid: Punchlines that wink at the player.
Direct allegations about living people or real companies.
Random chaos with no strategic choice.
Science-fiction language that obscures the mechanical rule.

box.frontStrapline: Build the future. Power the future. Announce the future before anyone else.
box.backCopy: The prototype worked. Capital arrived. Now six institutions race across a modular economy for compute, talent, energy, customers, and historical legitimacy. Choose only three priorities each quarter. Build powered networks. Push Training Runs until they succeed or collapse. Negotiate infrastructure with rivals who fully intend to outgrow you. Manage public Scrutiny while increasingly irresponsible options become available. In the final Era, deploy agent swarms, ignite a fusion demonstrator, and plausibly declare AGI. The world remains solemn. Nobody acknowledges that this is ridiculous.
box.shortPitch: A spatial engine-building and negotiation game about institutions racing to plausibly declare AGI.
box.contentWarning: Satirical themes include layoffs, surveillance-adjacent institutions, energy consumption, political influence, and technological crisis.

worldPrimer: In 2038, intelligence is no longer discussed as a property of minds. It is discussed as capacity, market access, and an item on the quarterly agenda.

Research institutions have become territorial infrastructure companies. Energy ministries negotiate directly with model releases. Public confidence is measured continuously and understood retrospectively.
Six institutions believe they can build the system that history will recognize as general intelligence. None agree on what that means. All agree that somebody else must not announce it first.

agiDeclarations.statement: Following extensive consultation, we have reached broad alignment that the system has crossed the relevant threshold.
General intelligence is now available to everyone by default. Settings may vary by region.
The result exceeds every benchmark we still consider scientifically meaningful.
The system is general, operational, and already scheduled for orbital deployment.
Subject to the safeguards described in Appendix M, we believe the responsible term is AGI.
Whatever intelligence is, demand for it has entered volume production.
